failure_reason: Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl_cffi) was blocked on every /c/ category URL with an Akamai 'Access Denied' (403) response, even though the homepage and the /view/NavigationBarComponentController JSON nav endpoint returned 200. Tier (b) headless Playwright hit the identical instant Akamai 'Access Denied' on the same /c/ URLs. Tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome (a real, previously-authenticated browser session) successfully loaded dozens of /c/ category pages and captured live 'N products found' counts, but partway through the Bathroom/Towels research the same Akamai block began firing on tier (c) as well (confirmed on both a new URL and a previously-successful URL, e.g. /c/home/storage/W134360 which had returned 200 minutes earlier). Per the hard rule to stop on first block per tier and not chase a block, research was stopped at that point. As a result the Home Decor (Cushions, Rugs & Mats, Blankets & Throws), Laundry, Kitchen, Dining and Outdoor Living category trees were never researched, and within Bathroom the Hand Towels qty, plus Bathroom Storage, Bathroom Accessories and Shower Curtains subcategories, were not captured. All rows below were captured live before the block hit; nothing was fabricated or estimated.
notes: ACCESS: robots.txt (fetched via curl_cffi) has no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-* disallow, only a generic User-agent:* block on /checkout,/my-account,/search etc plus a Sitemap pointer - tier (c) was not blocked by robots.txt, only by Akamai bot-manager mid-session. Tier (a) curl_cffi (impersonate=chrome124): homepage (200) and /view/NavigationBarComponentController?isJson=true (200, full mega-menu JSON) worked, but every /c/ category/listing URL returned Akamai 403 Access Denied - used to build part of the initial category tree only. Tier (b) Playwright headless chromium: identical instant 403 on /c/ URLs, confirms not a curl-fingerprint issue. Tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome (shared, already-connected real browser session): worked for ~40 category page loads (Storage tree, full Bedroom+Kids Bedroom textile tree, 6 of 7 Towels sub-pages) before the same Akamai wall appeared on this tier too; stopped per rule 4/STEP1. TREE: built from the union of the /view/... mega-menu JSON (Home > Categories list + Bedroom/Bathroom mega-menu columns) and each category page's own sub-category chip strip (read via accessibility tree / get_page_text), cross-checking h1/breadcrumb against the requested slug on every leaf recorded. QTY: taken verbatim from each listing page's own 'N products found' text, re-verified against the page breadcrumb/H1/title to rule out stale reads (the browser tool occasionally returned a stale count from the previous page - every count below was confirmed against a matching page title/breadcrumb before being recorded). EXCLUDED: Kids Bedroom Décor, Kids Bedroom Furniture, Kids Bedroom Lighting (Furniture/Lighting/Decor boundary, not Textile/Storage); Kids Bedroom Rugs (3 products, all EVA foam play mats e.g. 'Round The Town Playmat' - foam is not a textile material per textile.md Section 16/17, and foam play mats are closer to play-flooring than a fabric rug, so excluded rather than force-included on the category name alone); Bedroom > Comforter Sets (/c/home/bedroom/comforter-sets/W121220263) - this mega-menu-listed URL 404s live on the site ('Hmm... That's not supposed to happen') so it was dropped rather than fabricated; Bathroom > Bathroom Scales (fixture/appliance, not Textile or Storage); Bathroom > 'Grandeur Towels', 'Australian Cotton Towels', 'Egyptian Cotton Towels', 'Stripe/Ribbed/Tassel Towel Collection' chips - these are brand/material-filtered views of the same Towels catalog (duplicate listing pages of Bath Towels/Bath Mats/etc, akin to a Collection page per textile.md Section 15/27), not distinct subcategories, so only the genuine subcategory chips (Bath Mats, Bath Sheets, Bath Towels, Beach Towels, Face Washer, Hair Towels, Hand Towels) were recorded. Electric Blankets and Bed/Mattress Underlays were included as Textile at MEDIUM confidence: Electric Blankets is a fabric blanket with an integrated heating element (hybrid textile/appliance, not explicitly named in textile.md's list); Bed Underlay is not explicitly named in textile.md but is functionally identical to the explicitly-included Mattress Toppers/Protectors. Bed Pillows (the filled sleep pillow, distinct from Pillowcases which are separately and explicitly Textile) were included at MEDIUM confidence by analogy to Quilts/Duvets/Comforters, which are explicitly-included filled bedding items despite also having a 'filling'. Storage > Hangers included at MEDIUM confidence solely because Target's own site navigation places it directly under the Storage category (ambiguity rule: website's own classification is a decision factor) even though a bare coat hanger is not itself a container/organizer. Parent/grouping URLs (Bedroom, Kids Bedroom, Bathroom, Towels, Storage) were never recorded as their own row per the parent-category-URL rule since each has valid recorded subcategories.
